author.title: about me
author.p1: My name is Alexandre Maurice. I work in computer science, and I practice photography.
author.p2: I'm interested in photography, computing and, more broadly, anything that benefits from being simple: tools you can understand, things that last, work done with care.

site.title: about this site
site.p1: I'm a computer scientist, not a designer. I have always liked extreme restraint, a kind of visual austerity where nothing stands between the viewer and what they came to see.
site.p2: Today, too many websites are bloated: heavy, slow, cluttered with effects and features nobody needs. They are built to impress or to hold attention, rarely for the person actually using them.
site.p3: This site takes the opposite approach: text, photos, and nothing more. No animations, no ornaments, only what is needed to look at the pictures.
